festivals.what: Nikko Toshogu grand festival: 17 and 18 May every year; yabusame horseback archery on 17 May from 1pm; the procession of 1,000 samurai (Hyakumono-zoroe Sennin Musha Gyoretsu) on 18 May from 11am.

layers.process: The nature trail from the east side of the shop at Yudaki Falls parking lot to Kotaki Falls, on the route between Yudaki Falls and Senjogahara, is closed for boardwalk repair work from 18 August 2026 to the end of March 2027. The notice marks the green-marked trail between Yudaki and Senjogahara as the route to use, and the waterfall viewing platform stays open. Enquiries: 0288-21-1180.
